# LR Higgins Consulting

> Written operations manuals and checklists for small businesses. Based in Raleigh, North Carolina, USA. Contact: office@lrhigginsconsulting.com

LR Higgins Consulting writes operations manuals for small businesses from interviews with the owner: opening, closing and weekly
checklists, step-by-step task procedures with photos, new-starter packs, and a yearly refresh of each manual.
Fixed prices per document, in US dollars: checklist set (up to 5) $450; task procedures, per 10 $900; new-starter pack
$750; full operations manual $2,400; yearly refresh $480. Writing only -- no accounting, tax, legal or HR matters, no
hiring or staffing, no software set-up.

## Pages
- /operations-manuals.html: the full manual, task procedures and the yearly refresh
- /checklists.html: opening, closing and weekly checklists
- /new-starter-packs.html: first-week packs for a new team member
- /how-we-work.html: who the business is and how a job runs
- /request-a-manual.html: the request form with a running total
- /fees-and-refunds.html: deposit, stages, cancellation and refunds
